mathematics.assertion_tested: Bounded nonlinear trajectory crossing fractions and coupled coarse/fine consistency under delayed stationary OU forcing.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE float64; exact OU endpoint transitions, time-dependent velocity Verlet for the forced Duffing orbit.
mathematics.conventions: Fixed bare-energy cutoff ER=1; initial E=1-sigma; common random paths across amplitudes and resolutions; crossings are diagnostic, not killed or reflected.
non_claims: No universal crossing probability, exact stochastic solution, or empirical evidence.
Wilson intervals omit numerical discretization bias; timestep comparison separately records it.
No physical moving escape boundary or microscopic selector force is modeled.
